headline: Stellantis Halts Production and Advances Factory Vacations Amid Falling Demand
summary: Automaker Stellantis adjusted manufacturing activity at its plants in Buenos Aires and Córdoba, halting production and advancing vacations due to declining sales and export retractions.
why: Stellantis is one of the world's largest automotive groups, and production adjustments in South America highlight weaker regional consumer demand and manufacturing headwinds.

impacts.name: Stellantis NV
impacts.why: Softening vehicle demand necessitates lower production output and temporary plant closures.
